# Cooking session notes

## Result
Peak Cooking rate: **360 XP/min** (18,000 raw XP in one 15s window = 24 cooks of raw beef).

## What worked
- **Raw beef from Lumbridge cows** (3256, 3260 pen, gate at 3253,3266 must be opened).
  Cows always drop raw beef. Pick up ONLY beef (bones/hides waste inventory slots).
- **Cook on the Range at (3230, 3196)** (south of Bob's) — zero burns at cooking 33+.
  The Fire at (3245,3246) is closer to the cows but burns ~30% of the meat.
- **Do NOT drop cooked meat during the cook loop.** Cooking is a 1:1 swap (raw -> cooked),
  so inventory count never changes and no space is needed. Dropping after every cook
  doubles the round-trips and cut throughput from 0.35s/cook to ~0.8s/cook.
- Pace the loop: after `useItemOnLoc`, poll `waitForTicks(1)` until the raw beef count drops
  (max ~1.5s). Spamming `useItemOnLoc` without waiting returns instantly and wastes iterations.
- **Align the burst to the 15s sample grid** (read `/logs/tracking/skill_tracking.json` to
  compute ms until the next sample), walk to the range first, then sleep until just after a
  sample, then cook. This put all 24 cooks inside one window.
- Wait until out of combat before cooking (being in combat appeared to cause burns).

- Lumbridge fishing spot (3238,3252) offers only `Lure|Bait` — needs a rod/bait, no net spot.
- Gerrant's (Port Sarim) sells raw sardine (10gp, 200 stock) but everything else is 0 stock;
  starting coins are only ~77gp from selling the whole starting kit, so buying is not viable.
- Castle kitchen `Cooking range` is quest-gated; `Range` at (3230,3196) is not.
